mapper.select: SELECT GOAL_ID AS goalId, ID AS id, GOAL_TITLE AS goalTitle, TARGET_AMOUNT AS targetAmount, CURRENT_AMOUNT AS currentAmount, END_DATE AS endDate FROM SAVINGS_GOAL WHERE ID = #{ownerId} ORDER BY END_DATE ASC, GOAL_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SAVINGS_GOAL (ID, GOAL_TITLE, TARGET_AMOUNT, CURRENT_AMOUNT, END_DATE) VALUES (#{id}, #{goalTitle}, #{targetAmount}, 0, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE SAVINGS_GOAL SET GOAL_TITLE = #{goalTitle}, TARGET_AMOUNT = #{targetAmount}, END_DATE = #{endDate} WHERE GOAL_ID = #{goalId} AND ID = #{id} AND CURRENT_AMOUNT <= #{targetAmount}
UPDATE SAVINGS_GOAL SET CURRENT_AMOUNT = CURRENT_AMOUNT + #{amount} WHERE GOAL_ID = #{goalId} AND ID = #{ownerId} AND CURRENT_AMOUNT + #{amount} <= TARGET_AMOUNT
UPDATE SAVINGS_GOAL SET CURRENT_AMOUNT = CURRENT_AMOUNT - #{amount} WHERE GOAL_ID = #{goalId} AND ID = #{ownerId} AND CURRENT_AMOUNT >= #{amount}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SAVINGS_GOAL WHERE GOAL_ID = #{goalId} AND ID = #{ownerId}
